title: WinLean profile
description: A named selection of rules. The authoritative validator is src/WinLean.Validation.psm1; this schema provides editor support.

name.description: Profile name. Must match the file name (Profiles/<name>.json).

extends.description: Name of the profile this profile builds on, or null. Inherited rules come first.

rules.description: Rule ids added by this profile, in the order they should be evaluated.

exclude.description: Inherited rule ids this profile removes.

maxRisk.description: Highest rule risk this profile may contain. Loading fails if a rule exceeds it.

allowIrreversible.description: Whether irreversible rules are allowed (default false; never true for Safe or Lean).
